card.name: The word dry in powder and weight
card.fires_on: The word "dry" in drug labels, mostly before powder or material in reconstitution steps, and also in "dry weight". It fires weakly on a few other words such as "Until", "red" and "of".

modes.description: Occasional hits on words like "Until", "red" or "of" in treatment-duration or blood-cell text.
modes.example: in the absence of unacceptable toxicity or loss<< of>> disease control.
